fluff.overview: The AFFS treats its infantry as professionals rather than expendable garrison filler, drawing soldiers from single worlds or neighboring systems to build the unit cohesion that the Federated Suns considers essential to effective combined-arms operations. Jump-capable infantry provide the vertical mobility that AFFS commanders prize in urban combat and rough terrain, able to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions that ground-bound platoons cannot reach. Carrying infantry-scale gauss rifles that use magnetic acceleration to propel projectiles at extreme velocities, these platoons field the longest-ranged and hardest-hitting personal ballistic weapon available to conventional soldiers.
